title: Jellyfin 12.0
summary: Jellyfin 12.0 is a major release of the free, open-source media server software that allows users to organize, stream, and access their personal media collections. This release includes performance improvements, new features, and bug fixes for the self-hosted entertainment platform.
problem_solved: Provides a free, open-source alternative to proprietary media servers like Plex and Emby for self-hosting personal media streaming services.
why_valuable: Gives users complete control over their media without subscription fees, vendor lock-in, or tracking, while maintaining a strong community-driven development model.
